name: Skycap'n Kragg
guide_text: Most commonly, you use your hero power on turn 6 when you level to 4 in order to stabilize on tavern 4. Stabilize means you buy either good standalone cards or good synergy with your board.
buddy_guide_text: Buddy up for at most 3 gold. It'll give you 8 gold back.
